answer: Make each agent identity lock a refundable stake before it can earn, slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. One honest agent pays once, but a Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for every fake identity, so cost rises with each copy. Cheap clones may spread like yarrow across a tundra, yet reaching the summit of paid, trusted work still requires one real stake per identity, making a large fake fleet uneconomical.
